entries.description: And how is there resolution face-to-face?
entries.subject: And how

spans.text: And how is there resolution face-to-face?
Evaṁ kho, ānanda, sammukhāvinayo hoti; That’s how there is resolution face-to-face.
And how is there majority decision?
And how is there resolution through recollection?
Evaṁ kho, ānanda, sativinayo hoti, evañca panidhekaccānaṁ adhikaraṇānaṁ vūpasamo hoti yadidaṁ— That’s how there is the resolution through recollection.
And how is there resolution because of past insanity?
Evaṁ kho, ānanda, amūḷhavinayo hoti, evañca panidhekaccānaṁ adhikaraṇānaṁ vūpasamo hoti yadidaṁ— That’s how there is resolution because of past insanity.
And how is there acting according to what has been admitted?
And how is there a verdict of further penalty?

entries.description: After approaching a more senior mendicant

spans.text: Tena, ānanda, bhikkhunā vuḍḍhataraṁ bhikkhuṁ upasaṅkamitvā ekaṁsaṁ cīvaraṁ katvā pāde vanditvā ukkuṭikaṁ nisīditvā añjaliṁ paggahetvā evamassa vacanīyo: After approaching a more senior mendicant, that mendicant should arrange his robe over one shoulder, bow to that mendicant’s feet, squat on their heels, raise their cupped palms, and say: ‘ahaṁ, bhante, itthannāmaṁ āpattiṁ āpanno, taṁ paṭidesemī’ti.
